name: Materials Science Minor
intro: A minor in materials science is open to all undergraduate students in engineering. This minor provides students with the background and skills necessary to understand and use advanced materials in different engineering applications. Students are required to complete a minimum of 16 units of course work consisting of both core requirements and elective courses.

courses.title: Introduction to Machine Learning for Materials
Nanostructured Materials: Design, Synthesis and Processing
Computational Materials I: Introduction to Atomistic Simulation
